name: Sheariah
overview: Sheariah was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Azel. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or details about his life or role. He is recognized primarily through his genealogical connection within the tribe.
namesAndTitles: The name Sheariah is a proper name that possibly means 'YHWH breaks,' indicating a theophoric element referencing the Lord. This name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:38 and does not appear to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Sheariah as the son of Azel, establishing his place within the Benjaminite lineage. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Sheariah's significance lies chiefly in his genealogical listing, which contributes to the biblical record of the tribe of Benjamin. His inclusion helps preserve the lineage and heritage of this tribe, underscoring the importance of family lines in God's unfolding plan. While not prominent in narrative events, such genealogies affirm God's providential care over His people.
